title: Project Atlas kickoff

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Welcome to the Atlas kickoff. Goal for today: agree scope for GA, pick a design partner, and figure out what Enterprise actually means.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Atlas replaces the Cloud Console. Multi-site fleet view, scheduling, and over-the-air firmware rollout for R2 Pickers. Pricing is forty dollars per robot per month, Enterprise at fifty-five.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: OTA rollout is the part I care about most. Staged rollouts, with a pause button. We are not pushing firmware to a whole fleet at once ever again.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: On design partner, I'd push hard for Globex Logistics. 120 robots, they renew in November, and Dana Whitfield, their IT director, has basically been asking for this for a year.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Agree. They're our most engaged account. But Dana's first question will be SSO. Their security team won't approve any SaaS without SAML.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Which is why SSO is in the Enterprise tier. Devon, what's realistic?

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Plan is to broker through KeyGate Identity so we don't hand-roll SAML for every IdP. I've done a spike against their sandbox. Login works, metadata parsing works. Production hardening is maybe six weeks.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Six weeks of Devon is a lot when he's also on call. I'll protect his time from August on.

transcript.speaker: kai@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Design-wise, I need the onboarding flow and the fleet overview first. SSO login screen is small but I want it in the design system, not a one-off.

transcript.speaker: raj@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Let's keep GA scope tight. Fleet view, scheduling, OTA, SSO for Enterprise. Analytics is post-GA.

transcript.speaker: lena@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Can I tell Globex we're targeting end of September?

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Say 'targeting late Q3', not a date. We'll set the real date at a go/no-go in September.

transcript.speaker: omar@northwind.dev
transcript.text: I'll set up a design partner call with Dana in the next two weeks.

transcript.speaker: jordan@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Tracking: I'll make ATL-200 the GA epic and Devon owns the SSO ticket under it.

transcript.speaker: devon@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Works. I'll also get a named contact at KeyGate, their partner SE.

transcript.speaker: sam@northwind.dev
transcript.text: Great. I'll write the PRD and launch plan this week. Thanks everyone.

summary: Kickoff for Atlas Fleet Manager. GA scope set to fleet view, scheduling, staged OTA firmware rollout, and SAML SSO for the Enterprise tier ($40/robot/month, Enterprise $55). Globex Logistics (120 robots) chosen as design partner; Omar flagged that Globex requires SAML SSO before rollout. SSO will be brokered via KeyGate Identity, owned by Devon. Launch target communicated externally as late Q3, with a firm date to be set at a September go/no-go.
decisions: Globex Logistics is the Atlas design partner.
GA scope: fleet view, scheduling, staged OTA rollout, and SAML SSO via KeyGate for the Enterprise tier; analytics deferred post-GA.
